description: This file is a fuzzing test for the CanonicalCookie class and related cookie utilities in the net::cookies namespace, designed to test cookie creation, comparison, and validation functions using randomized input data.

classes.name: CanonicalCookie
classes.description: Represents a sanitized, canonicalized HTTP cookie with methods for comparison and validation.

methods.name: getRandomTime
methods.description: Generates a random time within the range of 0 to maximum uint64 value using fuzzed data.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: Fuzzer entry point that consumes input data to create and validate cookies, checking their properties and comparison functions.
